utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the twenty-second. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, we can hear you. I'm mainly here to complain about the broken coffee machine in the canteen. That powdered stuff is criminal.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's not coffee, that's a test of commitment.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: After the traffic on the ring road, I'd have drunk anything. Absolutely solid coming round this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely start, then. Tomasz, you're showing as muted.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: There we go. Headset button and Teams button. Always pick the wrong one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we're all here. Quick run through what's finished first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the GT2 bearing last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Oh, that was finished on nights, was it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, all finished. Not something we need to carry forward.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the 11kV Switchboard on Tuesday — this morning, I mean. Already signed off.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same here, signed off the inspection on the Main Outfeed Conveyor on Tuesday. Got that closed before this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, those are off the list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Only other thing from me, saw the pressure on the wrapper dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: It recovered without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, nobody touched anything. Just an observation, not bringing a repair job in.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I noticed the turbine two was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, it had settled by handover. Nothing ongoing there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both noted as observations.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The air dryer is still blocked, though. We can't get to the air dryer until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We haven't got a window available. Still the same position, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays parked. Not putting it into today's work.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the IM3, but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Ah, right. I remembered seeing that on the old list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, the old entry isn't live for today. Leave that one out.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the line 2 interlock by the end of the week. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide Adeyemi. That's the risk assessment update, rather than doing the interlock work itself?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll update the risk assessment. I'm not committing to the physical work as part of that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, useful distinction. People hear 'interlock' and assume we're already into the panel.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Normal priority, by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round by end of day, while we're on the paperwork bits.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the handover report we've already got, yeah? Not another version of the thing?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that one. Just sending it round, not creating a second report.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Hannah. Sending the shift handover report round by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I'll sort the training records for the new starters if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Olumide Adeyemi, that's definitely an 'if you've got a spare minute' one. Not pushing the other work out.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Spare-minute job, no fixed date on that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just the records, isn't it? Not another round of training?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just sorting the training records for the new starters. That's all I'm taking on there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, agreed on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got another one. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 1 TCU by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there — line 1 TCU?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, line 1 TCU. It's not an emergency but don't let it slip, that sort of priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Hannah. Recalibrate the sensors by Thursday; not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, so not a panic job. Just making sure I heard that properly.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No panic. I'll have that recalibration done by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marc, can you run the monthly fire alarm test? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the routine monthly one, isn't it? Sorry, spoke over you.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just the routine monthly test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it. No emergency response implied, but don't let it slip, Marc.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Understood. I've got that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Marc, can you inspect the feedwater pump for leaks by Thursday? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll inspect the feedwater pump for leaks by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: We're talking inspection only there?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Inspection for leaks, yeah. Not saying I'm replacing anything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. It matters but it's not urgent. Thursday is the deadline for that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Fine by me. Those two are clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. That's the agreed work, then. Nothing else to squeeze in?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Only my coffee grievance, and that's not an engineering request, before anyone writes it down.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. I don't think there's a calibration setting for 'drinkable'.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And just checking the finished bits don't get copied back into the open list. The GT2 bearing's definitely done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Finished items stay closed, observations are just observations, and the blocked and postponed bits stay out.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: All clear here, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. I'll let you get off Teams.
